# Goal 

make a few simple graphs to viz growth in DUC access requests since portal inception.

# Functions

```{r, functions}

```

# Setup

```{r, setup}
# source rmarkdown_setup.R
source("~/Setup/rmarkdown_setup.R")

# Load libraries silently
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(stringr)
  library(ggplot2)
  library(lubridate)
  library(glue)
})
```

# Main

plot number of distinct requests received each year

```{r}
fid <- "../all_approved_requests.csv"
all_approved <- read.csv(fid, check.names = FALSE)
distinct_approved <- group_by(all_approved, `Project Lead`, Institution) %>%
  tidyr::nest()
df <- purrr::map(distinct_approved$data, function(df) {
  df <- df %>%
    arrange(year) %>%
    slice(1)
  return(df)
})
df <- bind_rows(df)
distinct_approved <- bind_cols(distinct_approved, df)

by_year <- group_by(distinct_approved, year) %>% summarise(count = n())
by_year <- filter(by_year, year != 2026)
by_year$year <- factor(as.character(by_year$year))

p <- ggplot(by_year, aes(x = year, y = count, group = 1)) +
  geom_point() + geom_line() + theme_minimal() +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 10),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 10), 
        title = element_text(size = 10)) +
  ylim(0, max(by_year$count) + 10) +
  labs(title = "New ARK Portal Approved Access Requests", 
       subtitle = "excludes renewed DUC events")
fid <- glue("{fid.prefix}.new_by_year.png")
png(fid, width = 1000, height = 650, res = 250)
print(p)
invisible(dev.off())

YoY <- purrr::map(c("2024", "2025"), function(yr, df) {
  n1 <- filter(df, year == as.numeric(yr))$count
  n0 <- filter(df, year == as.numeric(yr) - 1)$count
  yoy <- round((n1 - n0) / n0 * 100, 1)
  return(glue("{yoy}%"))
}, df = by_year)
by_year$YoY <- c(NA, YoY)
my_kable_table(by_year, cap = "New Approved Access Requests by Year")
```

```{r, out.height="80%"}
knitr::include_graphics(fid)
```

# Renewals

```{r}
fid <- "../all_approved_requests.csv"
all_approved <- read.csv(fid, check.names = FALSE)
# assess renewed DUCs
renewed_DUC <- group_by(all_approved, `Project Lead`, Institution) %>%
  tidyr::nest()
test <- unlist(lapply(renewed_DUC$data, nrow))
idx <- which(test > 1)
renewed_DUC <- renewed_DUC[idx, ]
renewed_DUC <- tidyr::unnest(renewed_DUC, cols = c(data))
```
